design.name: 禺强
design.brief: Chapter boss Yuqiang (禺强), god of the North Sea and the north wind in the Shan Hai Jing: 'a human face and a bird's body, a green snake hanging from each ear, treading on two red snakes'. A colossal storm god with a stern human face with a frost-white beard, the body of a huge dark-blue sea eagle with vast wings whose feathers end in ice, a green serpent hanging from each ear, its talons gripping two writhing red serpents; a whirlwind of snow under it. A glowing jade-green wind pearl set in its chest (weak spot). Majestic and wild.
design.weapon: wings raised, a blizzard gust blowing from its wings
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert roster (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges, ice as a few big faceted shapes, paper and cloth as thick simple bands, fur as big carved clumps.
